annotations.text:
A. Project-first, like Premiere. The rail is always there, so New and Open stop moving with the mode choice, and recents become a sortable table that reads the same at 3 projects or 30.

Tradeoff: the main job is two clicks away.

B. Same structure, 96x54 thumbnails and the source filename. Keeps the recognition your cards gave you at about a third of the height.

Tradeoff: fewer rows visible than A.

C. Action-first, closer to OpusClip. Dropping a recording IS the home screen; recents sit underneath, and the right column counts clips rather than file bytes.

Tradeoff: projects feel secondary, which is wrong if you mostly return to work in progress.
